name: device-screenshot
description: Buttons that screenshot a connected iOS or Android device and attach the picture to your message.

interface.shortDescription: Screenshot a connected iOS or Android device into your message
interface.longDescription: A panel with a button for each booted iOS simulator, connected iPhone or iPad, and Android device or emulator. Press one to screenshot that device: the picture is added to your message as an attachment. Codex can also take a device's screenshot itself when you ask.
defaultPrompt: Screenshot my iPhone and tell me what is on screen
